snippet.text: - Check-run and lens reuse tests fail together on one CI Node version, every test that expects a run reused or attached failing and every other passing, and nothing reproduces alone. Cause: a test made and removed a package directory inside the checkout's own `node_modules`, and each test process keys Melian's install once, by walking that tree; a process whose walk met the directory, or lost it mid-walk, keys an install that reuses nothing. A loop doing the same beside `packages/pipeline/test/checks.test.ts` reproduces the 16 failures. A test never writes into the checkout's `node_modules`; one that needs a place inside Melian's install builds a scratch tree and points the code there, as `mutation-enumeration.test.ts` does with `fileURLToPath`.
